title: PostgreSQL: wal_level = replica gives CDC_NOT_ENABLED and an update that waits
symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_CDC_ERROR.CDC_NOT_ENABLED: "CDC is not enabled on User <user> ... wal_level is set to 'replica'. It should be set to 'logical'". The ingestion update stayed INITIALIZING for 20+ minutes with no events.
cause: Not established. The class the entry expected (PG_WAL_LEVEL_NOT_LOGICAL) wasn't seen.
effect: The update waits with no event.
fix: Set wal_level = logical and restart the server.
